Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: The Login message is the first message sent to the Spin Server by a user's process after the connection to the Spin Server is established. Failure to login before sending any other message type will result in the connection being dropped by the Spin Server. The format of the Login message for the Spin Server is identical to that of the GRP.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: The Login Response message is sent by the Spin Server to a user's process in response to a Login message. The status field is used to reflect an accepted login or the reason the session was not accepted. If login fails, the connection will be dropped after the Login Response message is sent.

Message.Name: Spin Image Available Message
Message.Description: The Spin Image Available message is sent once per second and indicates through what sequence number a spin is available.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Spin is available which is current through this sequence number.

Message.Name: Spin Request Message
Message.Description: The Spin Request message is used by a user's process to request transmission of a spin of the unit's order book.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from a Spin Image Available message received by the user.

Message.Name: Spin Response Message
Message.Description: The Spin Response message is sent in response to a user's Spin Request message indicating whether a spin will be sent.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from a Spin Image Available message received by the user.

Message.Name: Spin Finished Message
Message.Description: The Spin Finished message is sent to indicate that all messages for the spin requested have been sent. A Spin Finished message is only sent if a Spin Request message was not rejected.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from the Spin Request message.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Request Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Request message is used by a user's process to request transmission of this unit's Symbol Mappings.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Must be 0. Only the current Symbol Mappings are available.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Response Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Response message is sent in response to a user's Instrument Definition Request message indicating whether a spin will be sent.

Field.Name: Instrument Count
Field.Description: Number of Symbol Mapping messages which will be contained in this spin.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Finished Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Finished message is sent to indicate that all Symbol Mapping messages for this unit have been sent. An Instrument Definition Finished message is only sent if an Instrument Definition Request message was not rejected.

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: Symbol Mapping messages are sent in response to an Accepted Instrument Definition Request message.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces.

Message.Name: Trade Replay Request Message
Message.Description: The Trade Replay Request message is used by a user's process to request transmission of all Trade and Trade Break messages previously emitted by this unit prior to receiving the user's Trade Replay Request message.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Must be 0. All Trade and Trade Break messages available at the time of the request are sent.

Message.Name: Trade Replay Response Message
Message.Description: The Trade Replay Response message is sent in response to a user's Trade Replay Request message indicating whether a spin will be sent.

Field.Name: Message Count
Field.Description: Number of Trade and Trade Break messages which will be contained in this spin.

Message.Name: Trade Replay Finished Message
Message.Description: The Trade Replay Finished message is sent to indicate that all Trade and Trade Break messages for this unit have been sent. A Trade Replay Finished message is only sent if a Trade Replay Request message was not rejected.
